statutes.title: Rate of Tax on Interest and Dividends (Repealed Effective 2025)
text_en: Imposed 3.0% tax on dividend and interest income for 2024, fully repealed for tax periods beginning January 1, 2025 under 2023 HB 2 in New Hampshire.
text_es: Impuso 3.0% sobre dividendos e intereses en 2024, totalmente derogado a partir del 1 de enero de 2025 bajo la ley HB 2 de 2023 de New Hampshire.
